findings.title: Duplicated eligibility policy
findings.summary: Preview and Apply encode the same eligibility rule independently.
findings.whyItMatters: A business decision should have one authoritative implementation. A future policy change can make the preview disagree with the operation it predicts.
findings.impact: A future policy change can make the preview disagree with the operation it predicts.

evidence.message: Preview evaluates active status and country inline.
Apply repeats the inverse of the same policy.

findings.recommendation: Extract the eligibility decision into one private function used by both paths. This adds a small indirection, but it removes a meaningful consistency hazard without introducing a new abstraction layer.
